prepareInstallation.description: Deploys an Economy and its REP claim, configured and governed by the DAO's timelock.

components.name: arbitrationFeeBps
components.description: Share of a disputed project's funds paid to its arbiter.

components.name: platformFeeBps
components.description: Share of each payout that goes to the DAO treasury.

components.name: authorFeeBps
components.description: Share of each payout that goes to the project's author.

components.name: coolingOffPeriod
components.description: Time after signing during which a party can still back out. Never shorter than the DAO's proposal lifecycle.

components.name: backersQuorumBps
components.description: Share of a project's backers whose vote releases or disputes its funds.

components.name: projectThreshold
components.description: REP a member needs to create a project.

components.name: appealPeriod
components.description: Time to appeal an arbitration ruling to the DAO. Other modules' verdicts wait out this window too.

prepareUninstallation.description: Revokes the REP claim's minting rights and clears the Economy's registry entries. Projects in it keep running.
